title: Design System: Athena's Core — Obsidian (brand world)

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: Hero mount-in and scroll reveals; one authored motion, transform+opacity only.

components.name: Gold Button
components.description: Solid Attic Gold on ink; hover lifts to Electrum.
components.css: .btn-gold { background: #c9a24b; color: #070708; border: 1px solid #c9a24b; border-radius: 6px; padding: .9rem 1.75rem; font: 600 .85rem 'Hanken Grotesk'; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .btn-gold:hover { background: #e2c26c; border-color: #e2c26c; }

components.name: Codex Rule
components.description: 1px hairline hr with 48px gold prefix; brand-closed ornament.
components.css: .codex-rule { height: 1px; background: #1f2024; position: relative; } .codex-rule::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 48px; height: 1px; background: #c9a24b; }

narrative.northStar: The strategist's workbench — obsidian fields framed with electrum.
narrative.overview: Dark-native workspace brand: black-figure ink inverted into software. Gold is the signature and stays rare; flat classical layering instead of glow or glass.
keyCharacteristics: Ornaments closed set: meander, laurel, codex-rule
Calm strategist voice; no hype, no exclamation marks

rules.name: The Rarity Rule
rules.body: Attic Gold on no more than 10% of any surface; its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Locked Mark Rule
rules.body: The mark is never recolored, tinted, glowed, or restyled; approved presentations only.

dos: Do use the brand's dark layering — Ink Deep, Ink, Ink Raised + Hairline.
Do write copy in the calm strategist register.
Do let real captures carry the proof.
donts: Don't glow the mark or use glass/noise textures.
Don't mix Gold and Bronze on one canvas.
Don't use exclamation marks or hype words.
